# Saḷāyatanakathā (Kv 12.4)

**ID:** Kv 12.4
**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Saḷāyatanakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m3.mul19.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 While multiple reference works mention the term *saḷāyatana*, all retrieved secondary passages discuss the *Saḷāyatanavagga* or *Saḷāyatanasaṃyutta* of the *Saṃyutta Nikāya* rather than this *Kathāvatthu* chapter.

 However, machine analysis by DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse comprising 531 matching passages across 23 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. These matches consist largely of stereotyped debate structures shared with other sections of the *Kathāvatthu*, most prominently *Rūpaṁkammantikathā* (Kv 8.9), *Rūpaṁkusalākusalantikathā* (Kv 16.7), *Rūpaṁmaggotikathā* (Kv 10.2), *Rūpaṁvipākotikathā* (Kv 16.8), *Rūpaṁhetūtikathā* (Kv 16.5), *Rūpaṁsahetukantikathā* (Kv 16.6), and the preceding section *Saddovipākotikathā* (Kv 12.3) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records automated alignments with Chinese texts, including the *Madhyama-āgama* (T 26), the *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99), and the *Ren ben yu sheng jing* (T 14), as well as a low-scoring alignment with the Tibetan *Vinayapraśnaṭīkā* (D 4135) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Rūpaṁkammantikathā (Kv 8.9) (§1.5–1.7 ↔ §17.5–17.8); Rūpaṁkusalākusalantikathā (Kv 16.7) (§4.6–5.10 ↔ §6.2–7.11); Rūpaṁmaggotikathā (Kv 10.2) (§1.3–1.7 ↔ §1.3–1.8); Rūpaṁvipākotikathā (Kv 16.8) (§4.6–6.6 ↔ §1.4–4.4); Rūpaṁhetūtikathā (Kv 16.5) (§4.6–5.5 ↔ §2.2–3.4); Rūpaṁsahetukantikathā (Kv 16.6) (§4.6–5.5 ↔ §2.3–3.4); Saddovipākotikathā (Kv 12.3) (§4.6–6.2 ↔ §1.4–4.2); Jarāmaraṇaṁvipākotikathā (Kv 7.8) (§1.3–3.5 ↔ §1.3_2–3.6)
